description: Every card must carry a card_type from the fixed set, a taxonomy from this function's fixed set, and an evidence_grade from the fixed set.

rubric.condition: Every item in the cards array has a card_type value exactly equal to opportunity or threat.
Every item in the cards array has a taxonomy value exactly equal to one of this function's fixed taxonomy strings.
Every item in the cards array has an evidence_grade value exactly equal to strong, moderate or light.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md's Tagging rules and Evidence-grade honesty sections.
